summary.text: Iris Bender is the Democratic candidate for North Carolina House of Representatives District 87, running against incumbent Republican Destin Hall in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Her career experience includes working as a businesswoman.

paragraphs.text: In her Ballotpedia survey, Iris Bender said she would put Caldwell County's needs ahead of Raleigh politics.

Her stated priorities included workforce training through Caldwell Community College and Technical Institute, broadband expansion, and increased Medicaid reimbursement rates so that UNC Health Caldwell can hire and retain staff.
She also said she would work to eliminate the state's 2% sales tax on groceries and to increase childcare subsidy funding.
On education, she said she would seek to increase state funding for public schools and to pause or roll back voucher expansion until public schools are fully funded.
